research_question: Can the direct shared ACF/envelope/spectrum front end replace the expensive UNet ISRJ branch while preserving a useful recall gain under bounded false-positive risk?
frozen_main: P2c MLCNN IQ-Grouped task-routed checkpoints, seeds 2041/2042/2043

candidate.features: raw-IQ complex ACF, envelope ACF and spectrum pooled into frozen isrj_periodicity vector
candidate.routing: replace only ISRJ class probability; all other class and parameter outputs unchanged
candidate.threshold_selection: training-selection identities only; maximize mean recall subject to every regime-power observed FPR<=0.08 and CP95 upper<=0.15

next_if_pass: Freeze the shared router and perform batch-1/64 latency, FLOPs, memory and predicted-gate end-to-end attachment confirmation on another new identity seed.
stop_rule: If performance gates fail, do not replace P1n UNet and retain the 1.5x deployment gap as unresolved.
